records.source: I just like looking at the lights.#$b#It reminds me of something, long, long ago...$s
records.translation: 我只是喜歡看這些燈光。#$b#它讓我想起很久很久以前的某件事……$s

records.source: It's going to take a while, but I'm trying to get through all the books in the library.#$b#I have a lot of catching up to do...$s
records.translation: 雖然要花很久，但我正在努力讀完圖書館裡所有的書。#$b#我要補上的東西還很多……$s

records.source: Can't talk right now, @. I have to really focus...
records.translation: 現在不能說話，@。我得非常專心……

records.source: Oh, are you hungry? I already finished all the food...$u
records.translation: 喔，你餓了嗎？我已經把食物全吃完了……$u

records.source: We don't mind the rain too much, but it's nice to dry off in here sometimes.
records.translation: 我們不太在意下雨，不過偶爾進來把身體弄乾也很好。

records.source: Dammit... I almost forgot. I have to go see Doctor Harvey today.
records.translation: 該死……我差點忘了。我今天得去看哈維醫生。

records.source: Should I let Sam win for once? ...nah.$h
records.translation: 要不要偶爾讓山姆贏一次？……還是算了。$h

records.source: My skills haven't declined... Sam's still just as easy to beat.$h
records.translation: 我的技術沒有退步……山姆還是一樣容易打敗。$h

records.source: What are you doing in here? I could've been naked!$a
records.translation: 你在這裡做什麼？我剛才可能一絲不掛耶！$a

records.source: Mom's face lit up when I walked in. She deserves to be happy.$7
records.translation: 我走進去時，媽媽整張臉都亮了起來。她值得幸福。$7

records.source: I'm going to hang out with my old friends tonight. I'll be home later.
records.translation: 我今晚要和老朋友聚一聚，晚點會回家。

records.source: Standing at this spot really makes me want a smoke... but I'm determined to quit now.
records.translation: 站在這個地方真的讓我很想抽菸……但我現在決心戒掉了。

records.source: The ocean is best enjoyed alone... don't you think?
records.translation: 獨自欣賞海洋才最美好……你不覺得嗎？

records.source: I feel more relaxed at night... I might even buy a trinket.
records.translation: 夜裡我感覺比較放鬆……說不定還會買個小飾品。

records.source: Hmm... I have to say, JojaMart has a much better selection of frozen dinners.
records.translation: 嗯……不得不說，Joja 超市的冷凍晚餐選擇豐富得多。

records.source: I'm attached to these woods... lots of memories...
records.translation: 我對這片樹林很有感情……有太多回憶了……

records.source: Don't worry, this is only Joja Cola.
records.translation: 別擔心，這只是 Joja 可樂。

records.source: If I don't order a cold one now and then, Gus will go out of business. I'm just doing my civic duty. I'll head home around 10.
records.translation: 如果我不偶爾點杯冰啤酒，格斯就要倒閉了。我只是在盡公民義務。大約 10 點回家。

records.source: Oh, hey @. Miss me already?$6
records.translation: 喔，嘿，@。已經想我了？$6

records.source: I'm taking a night off from the saloon for Jas' sake...
records.translation: 看在賈斯的分上，我今晚不去酒館……

records.source: It smells bad in here.
records.translation: 這裡聞起來很糟。

records.source: I've got cola block... do I pick Joja Classic or Joja Bluu? I might be here a while...
records.translation: 我選可樂選到卡關了……該挑 Joja 經典還是 Joja 藍藍？我可能得在這裡待一陣子……

records.source: I'll just play one more round...$h
records.translation: 我再玩一局就好……$h

records.translation: 夜裡傳來了奇怪的聲音……

records.source: There was an earthquake during the night.

records.source: The Night Market is now open.
records.translation: 夜市現在開始營業。

records.source: It makes me glad to live on this vibrant world with you!
records.translation: 能和你一起生活在這個充滿活力的世界，真令我開心！

records.source: So empty, so lonely...
records.translation: 如此空曠，如此孤寂……

records.source: Here for one fleeting moment on its infinite journey.
records.translation: 在無盡旅程中，只於此刻短暫現身。

records.source: A rare wonder of the cosmos...
records.translation: 宇宙中罕見的奇景……
